quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: On a crosswalk.

activation.condition: Person stopping, standing or parking a vehicle on a crosswalk.

obligation.description: The stated stopping, standing or parking act on a crosswalk is prohibited unless a stated exception applies.

exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.description: Conflict and necessity need independent traffic and timing sources.
The independently applicable law and its scope need a sourced instruction.

exceptions.source_clause: or the directions of a police officer
exceptions.description: Officer identity, direction, scope and timing need source evidence.
Device authority, applicable direction, scope and timing need source evidence.

timing.description: Keep original 20 Hz activity, full vehicle footprint, crosswalk and exception histories throughout the delivered trace.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: Traffic trajectories and causal necessity remain unresolved by a boolean flag.
Independent legal authority and scope are required.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device
judgment_calls_needed.note: Authority, applicability and timing require independent review.

parameter_refs.name: halt_action
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: stop, stand or park; actual observed activity may differ

parameter_refs.name: destination
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: vehicle body on or wholly off mapped crosswalk

parameter_refs.name: exception_ground
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none, traffic conflict, law, police or official device
